tone={Polite:true Encouraging:true Direct:true Rationale:This change cannot merge in its current form due to a critical SSRF vulnerability (CWE-918) in the host allowlist validation. The suffix-match implementation at endpoint/endpoint.go line 35 permits look-alike hosts like evilapi.example.com to bypass an allowlist entry for api.example.com—a serious security defect that must be resolved before proceeding.

The good news: the fix is straightforward and well-scoped. The reviewer has already identified the solution: replace the suffix match with exact hostname equality comparison and skip empty allowlist entries. The rest of the implementation is solid—https enforcement, rejection behavior, and test coverage are all in good shape and need no changes.

To unblock this change, please implement the exact-match fix at line 35. As a minor follow-up, adding a line citation (line 20) to the AC1 evidence for the https scheme check would close challenge C2, though this does not affect the current blocker.

Once the hostname matching logic is corrected, this change will be ready to merge.} <nil>
